controls.title: Principles Relating to Processing of Personal Data
controls.description: Personal data shall be processed lawfully, fairly and in a transparent manner; collected for specified, explicit and legitimate purposes; adequate, relevant and limited to what is necessary; accurate and kept up to date; kept in a form which permits identification for no longer than necessary; processed in a manner that ensures appropriate security.
controls.supplemental_guidance: These are the foundational principles that all processing must adhere to.
assessment_objectives: Verify processing adheres to all six principles

controls.title: Lawfulness of Processing
controls.description: Processing shall be lawful only if and to the extent that at least one of the following applies: consent, contractual necessity, legal obligation, vital interests, public interest, or legitimate interests.
assessment_objectives: Verify lawful basis is identified for each processing activity

controls.title: Conditions for Consent
controls.description: Where processing is based on consent, the controller shall be able to demonstrate that the data subject has consented to processing. The request for consent shall be presented in a manner which is clearly distinguishable, in an intelligible and easily accessible form, using clear and plain language.
assessment_objectives: Verify consent mechanisms meet GDPR requirements

controls.title: Transparent Information and Communication
controls.description: The controller shall take appropriate measures to provide any information referred to in Articles 13 and 14 and any communication under Articles 15 to 22 and 34 relating to processing to the data subject in a concise, transparent, intelligible and easily accessible form, using clear and plain language.
assessment_objectives: Verify transparent communication with data subjects

controls.title: Information to be Provided (Direct Collection)
controls.description: Where personal data are collected from the data subject, the controller shall at the time provide the data subject with: identity and contact details of controller, purposes, legal basis, recipients, transfer details, retention period, and data subject rights.
assessment_objectives: Verify required information is provided at point of collection

controls.title: Information to be Provided (Indirect Collection)
controls.description: Where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject, the controller shall provide the data subject with the information within a reasonable period after obtaining the data, but at the latest within one month.
assessment_objectives: Verify information provision for indirect data collection

controls.title: Right of Access
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller confirmation as to whether or not personal data concerning him or her are being processed, and, where that is the case, access to the personal data and information including purposes, categories, recipients, retention, and rights.
assessment_objectives: Verify process for handling subject access requests

controls.title: Right to Rectification
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller without undue delay the rectification of inaccurate personal data concerning him or her.
assessment_objectives: Verify rectification request process

controls.title: Right to Erasure (Right to be Forgotten)
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to obtain from the controller the erasure of personal data concerning him or her without undue delay where one of specified grounds applies, including withdrawal of consent, objection to processing, or unlawful processing.
assessment_objectives: Verify erasure request process and execution

controls.title: Right to Data Portability
controls.description: The data subject shall have the right to receive the personal data concerning him or her, which he or she has provided to a controller, in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format and have the right to transmit those data to another controller.
assessment_objectives: Verify data portability capability

controls.title: Responsibility of the Controller
controls.description: Taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing as well as the risks of varying likelihood and severity for the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure and to be able to demonstrate that processing is performed in accordance with this Regulation.
assessment_objectives: Verify controller implements appropriate measures

controls.title: Data Protection by Design and Default
controls.description: The controller shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures for ensuring that, by default, only personal data which are necessary for each specific purpose of the processing are processed. That obligation applies to the amount of personal data collected, the extent of their processing, the period of their storage and their accessibility.
assessment_objectives: Verify privacy by design and default implementation

controls.title: Processor
controls.description: Where processing is to be carried out on behalf of a controller, the controller shall use only processors providing sufficient guarantees to implement appropriate technical and organisational measures. Processing by a processor shall be governed by a contract that is binding on the processor.
assessment_objectives: Verify processor agreements are in place with required terms

controls.title: Records of Processing Activities
controls.description: Each controller shall maintain a record of processing activities under its responsibility containing: name and contact details, purposes of processing, categories of data subjects and personal data, categories of recipients, transfers to third countries, time limits for erasure, and description of security measures.
assessment_objectives: Verify records of processing activities are maintained

controls.title: Security of Processing
controls.description: Taking into account the state of the art, the costs of implementation and the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing, the controller and the processor shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk, including: pseudonymisation and encryption; ability to ensure ongoing confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience; ability to restore availability in a timely manner; process for regularly testing and evaluating effectiveness of measures.
assessment_objectives: Verify security measures appropriate to risk are implemented

controls.title: Notification of Breach to Supervisory Authority
controls.description: In the case of a personal data breach, the controller shall without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after having become aware of it, notify the personal data breach to the supervisory authority, unless the personal data breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons.
assessment_objectives: Verify 72-hour breach notification process

controls.title: Communication of Breach to Data Subject
controls.description: When the personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall communicate the personal data breach to the data subject without undue delay.
assessment_objectives: Verify data subject breach notification process

controls.title: Data Protection Impact Assessment
controls.description: Where a type of processing in particular using new technologies, and taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing, is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall, prior to the processing, carry out an assessment of the impact of the envisaged processing operations on the protection of personal data.
assessment_objectives: Verify DPIAs are conducted for high-risk processing

controls.title: Designation of Data Protection Officer
controls.description: The controller and the processor shall designate a data protection officer in any case where: the processing is carried out by a public authority; the core activities consist of processing operations requiring regular and systematic monitoring of data subjects on a large scale; or the core activities consist of processing on a large scale of special categories of data.
assessment_objectives: Verify DPO designation where required

controls.title: General Principle for Transfers
controls.description: Any transfer of personal data which are undergoing processing or are intended for processing after transfer to a third country or to an international organisation shall take place only if the conditions laid down in this Chapter are complied with by the controller and processor.
assessment_objectives: Verify international transfer safeguards

controls.title: Transfers Subject to Appropriate Safeguards
controls.description: In the absence of an adequacy decision, a controller or processor may transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation only if the controller or processor has provided appropriate safeguards, including standard contractual clauses, binding corporate rules, or approved codes of conduct.
assessment_objectives: Verify appropriate safeguards for transfers (SCCs, BCRs)
